<p dir="auto" data-pm-slice="1 1 []">The <strong>Anhui Medical University CSC Scholarship</strong> is an <strong>international scholarship</strong> given by the Anhui Medical University to students who are pursuing a career in medical writing. The Anhui Medical University’s goal is to provide international scholarship opportunities to students who are pursuing a career in medical writing. The <strong>CSC Scholarship</strong> is one of the most prestigious scholarships awarded by the university, with priority given to those studying English, medical education, and research.</p>

<p dir="auto">The benefits of applying for this scholarship are that you can study in China while having the same living cost as being at home. This is because the scholarship covers all of your tuition fees, accommodation and healthcare costs with a monthly allowance for living expenses. You also have the opportunity to work part-time as a hospital assistant while you’re there.</p>
<p dir="auto">Anhui Medical University was founded in 1992 by Anhui Medical College which has been providing medical education in China since 1952. The university’s medical school offers undergraduate and postgraduate degrees with multiple disciplines including medicine, nursing, dentistry and more.</p>
<p><strong>Anhui Medical University</strong> was Dongnan Medical College, established in 1926 in Shanghai. Moved first to Huaiyuan County, Anhui Province, at the end of 1949, and then to Hefei, the capital of Anhui Province, in 1952, Dongnan Medical College changed its name to Anhui Medical College. In June, 1996, approved by the National Committee on Education, Anhui Medical College was renamed Anhui Medical University.</p>
<h2><strong>Anhui Medical University World Ranking</strong></h2>
<p>The World Ranking of Anhui Medical University is #684 in Best Global Universities. Schools are ranked according to their performance across a set of widely accepted indicators of excellence.</p>
<h2><strong>Anhui Medical University CSC Scholarship 2026</strong></h2>
<p><strong>Authority:</strong> Chinese Government Scholarship 2026 Through China Scholarship Council (CSC)<br />
<strong>University Name</strong>: Anhui Medical University<br />
<strong>Student Category</strong>: Undergraduate Degree Students, Masters Degree Students, and Ph.D. Degree Students<br />
<strong>Scholarship Type</strong>: Fully Funded Scholarship (Everything is Free)<br />
<strong>Monthly Allowance Anhui Medical University Scholarship</strong>: 2500 for Bachelors degree Students, 3000 RMB for Masters Degree Students, and 3500 RMB For Ph.D. Degree Students</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Tuition fees will be covered by CSC Scholarship</strong></li>
<li><strong>Living Allowance will be provided at your Bank Account</strong></li>
<li><strong>Accommodation </strong><strong>（</strong><strong>Twin beds room for undergraduates and Single for graduate students)</strong></li>
<li><strong>Comprehensive medical insurance (800RMB)</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Apply Method Anhui Medical University Scholarship</strong>: Just Online Apply (No Need To send hard copies)</p>

<h3><strong>Eligibility Criteria For Scholarship at Anhui Medical University</strong></h3>
<p>The <strong>Eligibility Criteria of </strong><strong>Anhui Medical University </strong><strong>for CSC Scholarship 2026 is mentioned below. </strong></p>

<li>Age limits for Undergraduate Degree is 30 year, for Masters degree is 35 year, and For Ph.D. is 40 Years</li>
<li>Applicant must be in good health</li>
<li>No criminal record</li>
<li>You can apply with English Proficiency Certificate</li>
</ol>
